value: Simulator outputs from placeholder profiles. Not laboratory measurements. Do not compare these figures to a retail set without saying they are synthetic.

blur_px is the 10-90 percent width of the pursuit-integrated edge after the full pipeline, so backlight spread is included. still_blur_px is that edge with motion off. temporal_blur_px is the 10-90 width of a sharp step through the temporal stage only (response, overdrive, BFI, pursuit), with backlight spread left out. motion_blur_px removes the still width from blur_px in quadrature and is not the temporal-only width.
profile duty is 1; comparison duty 0.5 is a harness stimulus, not a profile setting
profile gain is 0; probe gain 0.5 is a harness stimulus, not a profile value
